lokele: Iso Paulo la Timoteo bɛkɔwa ya Masiya Yesu, tosotoma e-lokasa-lo end’ino batotina ebüchomu ende Masiya Yesu ebayali nda bokenge wa Filipoi, la ende Bekumi la Basungi b’Etanda;
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, 1:1 to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers 1:1 and servants: 1:1

lokele: booto end’ino la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango wasu la elia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya! Kelekele la lisomboli lia Paulo
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Itofaekefa Mungu kelekele mbile la mbile ani itosingwaka baina banu nda basomboli bami,
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

lokele: eoka yanu yaatotina ko la limɛngɔ itosombokoel’ino la kelekele,
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

lokele: eoka ya lisungani lianu lasu nda limelanesi lia Mboli Ilau ko nda lise lia oso eliokak’ino yao ko nda kwani.
english: for your partnership 1:5 in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

lokele: Isoimela wewe to mbo Mungu oyasoakola ndokela likuwa lilau nda betema yanu, Inde nd’atɔɔlɔlɔ liao hɔlɔɔ nda lise lina lia Masiya Yesu.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

lokele: Engani nde lami ndoenyakel’ino yaatotina ongoma, eoka isami nd’ino nda botema wami, eoka nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ bosoyaiaka lami la nda ïmutoli liomutoela bawanjeli bami, la nda likɔkɔmɛsi lia Mboli Ilau wasukanaka lami lisaɔ lia booto wa Mungu, ino yaatotina.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

lokele: Mungu nd’aluwi fololo mbo isookel’ino yaatoti eniya efi la losamɔ lona elole la Masiya Yesu,
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

lokele: la loao elotosombokoela’mi ino lole mbo losamɔ loanu lonlweke la losɛngɛkɛ nda liluwani la nda wɛlï wolembeela obe la olau,
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

lokele: la mbo okulieke yao ebisolongela l’olau. Ongoma to mbo oyaleke la betema ya momongo, angokwa se nda loasɔ ko nda lise lia Masiya,
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

lokele: la mbo otumesomoko fuu la tuma etosokondaka nda liengani elisotela ko l’eoka ya Yesu Masiya mbo Mungu afomoko tala la iomala. Mboli ya boyaeli wa Paulo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

lokele: Bitungani yami, ilɛmbi to mbo oluweke njasɔ ebisoomana lami bisokɛsɛ Mboli Ilau ko la oso, bitikufese yao.
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, 1:12 that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

lokele: Ongoma basilikani ba Kaisala la bato basi batotina loluwa fololo mbo bɛnyɔlɔlɔ yami yende ko l’eoka ya Masiya;
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace 1:13 guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

lokele: la ko l’eoka ya bɛnyɔlɔlɔ yami, lilendelu lia wike wa Bitungani liolendelo Ngɛnɛ lisoulwa, la basotendela ndonangola lioi lia Mungu l’angwɛnɛ bɔwa.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

lokele: Nde bamɔi batonangoela Masiya ko l’eoka ya lisiela la bokele, nde basi ko la botema bolau;
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

lokele: eba basokelaka ani eoka ya losamɔ, eoka basoluwa mbo isotomo ono ko ndoaolela Mboli Ilau.
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

lokele: Kongo ko ebamɔi batonangoela Masiya ko la bokele la bosho inga la momongo, kangä eoka basotanga mbo batokesa’mi tale nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

lokele: ¿Loni to loasɔ? Kangä mbo Masiya asonangokoelomo la mboka bitotina, ango ko la bokwelakwela, ango ko la momongo; nda loasɔ-lo isoka limɛngɔ. Eingo ko, la yokaka nde limɛngɔ fuu
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

lokele: eoka iluwi nde mbo loao lotoeshela’mi louweso ko la basomboli banu ko la lifotesi lia Bolimo wa Yesu Masiya,
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

lokele: ani asotaenyela’mi la iɛli silau mbo itiokesomoko sɔni nda loasɔ ango lɔmɔi, kongo ko la lotendela lofi Masiya atotaliomo tala kwanikwani la nda mbile bitotina, ko la njasɔ ebitoyaka nda bindo yami, ango ndoika, ango ndowa.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

lokele: Eoka, ende’mi ndoyalaka la liwawi ende ngo ko ndowatemaka la Masiya, la ndowa ende ko bondanda wa botalia.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

lokele: Eya to mbo lole loami ndotikala nda bindo-ye, ambo likuwa liami litofota, nde itiangoluwes’ino eloaa.
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

lokele: Isoɛumɛlɛ nda njasɔ-bi bimbale; yende la yɛmɛ yosokwa nda liwawi-li la ndokayala la Masiya eoka loao lole la olau woeta,
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

lokele: kongo ko loasɔ lolongela lole ngo mbo itatikalaka nda bindo eoka yanu.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

lokele: Eokao, isoimela la wɛlï la wɛlï mbo itotikala la itoumwaka lanu yaatoti mbo ɔkɛkɛ la oso la limɛngɔ nda lilendelu lianu,
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

lokele: mbo wɛnɛkɛ litina elietami ndotalia Masiya Yesu tala loasɔ loami, eoka ya loyo loami end’ino liasi. Baoi bofumbesa bɔkɔkɔmu la bofiili
english: that your boasting 1:26 may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

lokele: Loasɔ-lo lɔmɔi loeti nde, loko mbo boyaeli wanu nda okenge boenganeke la Mboli Ilau ya Masiya, litina mbo, yeya ndoyɛn’ino, kwa mbo itiye, nde yokeke mboli ya boyaeli wanu mbo osokɔkɔmɔ kɔkɛ la botema ɔmwito, ani otonanela Mboli Ilau amamwito, la lisangi limɔi nda lilendelu,
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

lokele: la osisimwëke ango sinyo eoka ya biyani lanu; ongoma lotendela loanu lole ndembe yɔɛnɛs’iyo lɔsɛɛsɛlo loau la liuwesi lianu, mbo liao lisofomo nde ko la Mungu.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

lokele: Eoka osofaefomo isosha loasɔ loa Masiya, inga ko ndolendelo Inde kongo, kangä imɔ ndokaka biale wike eoka yande;
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

lokele: ino osonana bita ina eyɛnɛk’ino oso ende’mi la ebitöökel’ino kwani loasɔ loami.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

lokele: Eya to mbo Masiya eyala l’isosha shofumbes’ino, la losamɔ ango ko la booto wa Bolimo ango la ngandi la shota,
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

lokele: tumesaka botema wami la limɛngɔ ko la liyalani lianu la botema ɔmwito, la losamɔ ko lɔmɔi, la lisangani limɔi la lienyakeli limɔi imɔ.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

lokele: Okelëke loasɔ ango lɔmɔi ko la lomuli loa bɔmɛtɔ la lɔfɔlɔ, kangä la liikami se, la boto la boto atangeke mbo wina nd’alongel’inde angɛnɛ.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

lokele: Boto la boto atatakela ko eyande angɛnɛ bolenda, kangä imɔ ko eya bato basi.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

lokele: Yalaka to la bolimo ona nda betema yanu ewayalaka nda botema wa Masiya Yesu,
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

lokele: kwa ani ayalak’Inde la liluku lia Mungu angɛnɛ, atiatangaka mbo ndoyala la liluku lia Mungu lole loasɔ lotuchomo,
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

lokele: kongo ko Inde lɔwɛlɛ tala yande se waa, Inde lɔɔsɔ liluku lia bɔkɔwa ani aotomoko la bɔfɔnɔ wa boto;
english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

lokele: aoshomokö Inde la boyaeli wa boto angɛnɛ, Inde loikama imɔ se la lilitesi suu ko nda liwa, ambo liwa nda lieka angɛnɛ.
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

lokele: Eokao Mungu asotalia Inde tala likolo lia yaatotina, la asofaef’Inde lina liolongela baina batotina,
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

lokele: mbo nda lina lia Yesu, batotina baswakameke balwi se, ko eba Use la eba ono se, ko eba ewelo; la mbo
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

lokele: ndamɛ bitotina biaokoleke mbo YESU MASIYA ale NGƐNƐ mbo Mungu Sango inelomoko la tala. Bakakanelo ba Paulo ende baina lande
english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

lokele: Ongoma to, ebasamomu lami, kwa alitesak’ino oso, imɔ ko kwani kɔkɔmɛlɛkɛ nda liuwesi lianu la bɔwa la liwangi, inga ani ayali’mi lanu kongo nde simbi to ani itiyale tina lanu;
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

lokele: eoka ale ko Mungu oyatof’ino la lisangi la bofoka wokela kwa asolɛmb’Inde angɛnɛ nda likomyi liande.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

lokele: Kelaka bitotina ebikakelek’ino angokimakima la tofenya,
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

lokele: mbo oyaleke l’esaela l’angwɛnɛ litwanelo, kwa bana ba Mungu ebatiɛnɛlɛ la litwanelo atiteni ya fɛtɔ ya bato ba tofenya la bɛtɛkɔ; sisi ya bato ana, ino nd’atoɛnɛlɛ kwa tɔmwɛli nda wenda-bo,
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

lokele: ani ososɛlɛ Lioi lia loiko. Ongoma to mbo nda lise lia Masiya yomaleke mbo itikwe fɔmbi ko wawa, la mbo itikele likuwa lia bonui ko likeela.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

lokele: Ango liwawi liami liwɛlɔmɔ likolo lia litambi lia lilendelu lianu, imi kokaka limɛngɔ la imi kofichana lanu limɛngɔ finɛ.
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

lokele: Ino imɔ ko ongoma, okaka limɛngɔ la fichanaka lami limɛngɔ finɛ. Timoteo la Epafulotito batotomomo nda Filipoi
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

lokele: Nde iɛli shami, la Ngɛnɛ Yesu ekulya, sile shotoma Timoteo end’ino lisasaya, mbo imi imɔ yaimweke botema ani akokeke’mi mboli yanu.
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

lokele: Eoka iti la boto wasi wotakela bolenda wa njasɔ yanu kwa asokelak’inde;
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

lokele: eoka basi batotina batotutaka ko eyau njasɔ kongo, inga to eya Masiya Yesu.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

lokele: Oluwi nde mbo osokulya inde, mbo asosunga kwa sango la wana amamwito lami nde likuwa lia Mboli Ilau.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

lokele: Ile la iɛli shotom’inde nda mbile eyekaluweke’mi kwa atokomyomo loasɔ loami,
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

lokele: nde isolendelo Ngɛnɛ mbo imi angɛnɛ itoya end’ino lisasaya.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

lokele: Nde isoenyela mbo engani ndotomel’ino Epafulotito, ale etungani la bokuwani lami la bosilikani amamwito lami, al’imɔ wɛndi wanu oyasotom’ino otomela’mi ndoyasungaka’mi nda beeno ebile lami.
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

lokele: Eoka ayalaka la yɛmɛ yɔɛn’ino nda ikɛnɛnɛ shande eoka ino wokaka mbo ayalaka la lokambo.
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

lokele: Ayalaka nde la lokambo wewe oko tina lowa, nde Mungu lookel’inde ngandi, la inga to inde angɛnɛ kongo, kangä imɔ ko lami lisanga, mbo itoka ikɛnɛnɛ sha likama.
english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

lokele: Eokao isoumama otomel’ino inde lisasaya, mbo akɛnɛkɛ ino wɛnɛ inde liasi, bokeke limɛngɔ finɛ la mbo eshami ikɛnɛnɛ sisileke sumbu.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

lokele: Aelaka to inde la limɛngɔ la booto eoka ya Ngɛnɛ, litesaka ebayali kwa inde,
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

lokele: asikiowa eoka ya likuwa lia Masiya, ani ataka liwawi liande se kwa mbele mbo inde aɔlɔlɛkɛ lisungi eliomeluku ino liosunga’mi.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

lokele: Nda njasɔ ebimɔi, Bitungani yami, okaka limɛngɔ ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ; itiwe likati ndosɔnɛl’ino ko njasɔ-ao la bile yolendelomo lanu.
english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

lokele: La wɛlio eoka ya ebale kwa ngwa! Itoko imɔ ebatokelaka obe la yɛnɔ, imɔ ko ebatotinya totombe litinyela,
english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

lokele: eoka iso nd’ayali ebatotinya twao la wewe ebatosemola Mungu ko la Bolimo la ebatoomala ko l’eoka ya Masiya Yesu, la ebaitolendelo njasɔ ya bindo;
english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

lokele: ambo imi yende la litina liolendelo imɔ ko njasɔ ya bindo! Eya to mbo boto wasi etanga nde mbo ale la litina liolendelo njasɔ ya bindo, ambo simbi to imi!
english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

lokele: Yatinyomoko itombe nda lise lia bonanɛi, yende boto wa bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Isalaele, wa bofindi wa Benyamina, WaEbele wa lioti lia BaEbele, nda njasɔ ya Bikela yaaka WaFalusi;
english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

lokele: eoka ya bofimbi finɛ yakongolaka Etanda, la itiatwaneloko ango sinyo nda loasɔ loa lienganesi lia Bikela.
english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

lokele: Kongo ko yao ina ebilongiki lami, isotanga yao oko mbo ebisowela’mi ko l’eoka ya Masiya;
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

lokele: eingo nde, ikotanga bitotina oko mbo bisowa ko l’eoka ya ambɔlɛ wa bolau woluwaka Masiya Yesu, Ngɛnɛ wami. Ko l’eoka yande isolefesa bitotina la isotanga yao mbo ndɛlɔ, mbo yɔlɛkɛ Masiya kwa bondanda la mbo yoshaneke lande batebate,
english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

lokele: inga ani isɛli nde liengani liami angɛnɛ eliolitesa Bikela, kangä liengani liolendelo Masiya, liko liengani lia Mungu elisosekwa nda lilendelu.
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

lokele: mbo ani asokweela’mi boyaeli wa liwa liande, iluweke Inde angɛnɛ la bofoka wa litɛmwi liande, la likaɔ lia lisangani lande nda bemusi yande,
english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

lokele: mbo eluwa imi koiyela litɛmwi nda liwa.
english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

lokele: Ititange nde mbo isoiyela kɔni, kwa mbo isɔɔlwa kwani, kongo ko isokatutake mbo eluwa itukumeleke loao elosotukumelomo’mi ko la Masiya Yesu.
english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

lokele: Bitungani, ititange imi angɛnɛ mbo isoundaka isotukumela loao, nde loasɔ lɔmɔi elotokela’mi, loko mbo itoosakala njasɔ ebile ombisa yami, la itonanwa nano nda fɔmbi mbo yosheke ebile oso wami,
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

lokele: isoengaka nda elongelo, mbo yɔlɛkɛ bosömbo ebokafomoko bolongi boko ndotomo lioi omao likolo, ko ende Mungu ko l’eoka ya Masiya Yesu.
english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Eokao, iso ebale batowange nda lilendelu, toenyakeleke ongoma, la eya mbo boenyela la bɔfɔnɔ wasi, ani Mungu angɛnɛ eluwesak’ino imɔ ko loao.
english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

lokele: Kongo ko nda loao elosoiyel’iso kwani, tokɛndɛlɛkɛ ngo ko fii nda mboka ya loao.
english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

lokele: Bitungani, sanganaka ndotutakela’mi la wɛlɛkɛ bato bana baiso, ebatotutakela etichelo yasu;
english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

lokele: eoka isokambes’ino bakambesa wike la isokambes’ino kwani liasi ko la foo nda baiso, mbo bato wike batokɛndɛkɛndɛ la boyaeli wa biyani la lieka lia Masiya.
english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

lokele: Bato ana batotungama ngo ko nda losɛɛsɛlɔ, mungu yau ngo ko sɔlɔ; iomala shau ngo ko sɔni, batoenyakela ko njasɔ ya se.
english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

lokele: Eoka ewasu bokenge bole to nda Use, olo atokuswa Bouwesi oyatoumbakela iso oumbakel’Inde la iɛli sifi, ako Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya;
english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

lokele: Inde nd’atokindola bindo yasu ya mbuwa, nda bɔfɔnɔ wa bindo yande ya tala ya iomala ko la bofoka wa isosha shande shokakalesa yeka bitotina kakala end’Inde.
english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

lokele: Ongoma to Bitungani yami ebasamomu la ebale lami la yɛmɛ yɔɛn’ino, ebale limɛngɔ la boyoyo wa bowangɔ ende’mi, kɔkɔmɛlɛkɛ to ongoma basamomu lami, ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

lokele: Isolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Ewodia la isolɔmbɔkɔlɔ imɔ ko Suntuke mbo baluwaneke ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ;
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

lokele: eingo la isofela’aɛ oyale bosungani lami wa wewe, mbo osungeke e-batomali-ba, eoka iyo bakelakanaka lami likuwa lia Mboli Ilau, amamwito la Kulemento la basi imɔ ebakelanaka lami likuwa, bale la baina nda Lokasa loa Loiko.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

lokele: Okaka to limɛngɔ ko mbile bitotina ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ, isoonga ko ongoma liasi, mbo— Okaka limɛngɔ!
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

lokele: Bato batotina bɛnɛkɛ mbo ino angɛnɛ wende la limɛsɛkɛlɛni. Ngɛnɛ wasu ale tina!
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

lokele: Otakelëkë loasɔ ango lɔmɔi loanu bolenda, nde nda njasɔ bitotina luwesaka Mungu yao ebitofelak’ino ko la lisomboli la liömbi amamwito la kelekele imɔ.
english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

lokele: Limɔ lilatemi lia Mungu elilongeli wɛlï wasu bototina litotekamesa la betema yanu la basangi banu ko l’eoka ya Masiya Yesu.
english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Nda njasɔ ebitikali, Bitungani yami, enyakelaka la wɛlï njasɔ-bi, biko ebile wewe, ebile yolitekesomo, ebiengani, ebile la botanu, ebile yosamomo, ebile la lokuku lolau; beondo nde ndotaliomo la ndosemokolomo, ino koenyakela yao.
english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

lokele: Njasɔ imɔ ebisoekak’ino la ebisoael’ino ende’mi, la yao ebisokak’ino la ebisɔɛn’ino ani yayalaka lanu, kelakaka ngo ko yao; limɔ Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa lilatemi eyalaka nde lanu. Baoi ba kelekele ya Paulo eoka ya bɛkɛɛ eyatomaka baina
english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

lokele: Nde yende la limɛngɔ fuu eoka ya Ngɛnɛ, eoka osoakola oko liasi ndotakela bolenda wosunga’mi; watakelaka nde bolenda, kongo ko waenoko nde fofe yosunga’mi.
english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

lokele: Inga to mbo isoonga ani ko loasɔ loa boeno, eoka imi isoeka ndotekama teka nda boyaeli eboyali nde’mi;
english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

lokele: iluwi nde ndoyala ko mbuwa, la ndoyala imɔ la lilya. Nda njasɔ bitotina la loasɔ la loasɔ, imi nd’asoosha litina lioyala la lisängo, ango la isiye, ango la lilya, ango la mbuwa,
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

lokele: isokɔkɔlɔ bitotina ko lande oyatofaefa’mi bofoka wande ako Masiya.
english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

lokele: Nde wakeelaka’mi olau finɛ ani wokelaka’mi booto nda bifembi.
english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

lokele: Ino ba Filipoi imɔ nd’aluwi to mbo nda baakoelo ba likambesi lia Mboli Ilau olo nda Makedonia ani asokwaka’mi omao, angwɛnɛ Etanda yasi losukana lami lisaɔ liofaefa la liɔɔsɔkɔ bɔkɛɛ, sakolo ko ino kongo.
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

lokele: Nda bokenge wa Tesalonika imɔ, watomakaka bɛkɛɛ yoengana boeno wami batoma ango bambale.
english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

lokele: Loti to mbo isolola likaɔ, nde isolola tuma etosootaka kwa bosömbo nda lotango loanu.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

lokele: Isosɛlɛ to bitotina la yoeta, isokanelo imɔ ani asɔɔlɔ’mi bɔkɛɛ ewatomelak’ino’mi ko la Epafulotito; bole bɔkɛɛ wa liɛsɛ lilau, lifaefi elitoaelomo la olau la elitoomalesa Mungu finɛ.
english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

lokele: Nde Mungu wami, ko la lifoka lia tala elisosɛl’Inde, atofaef’ino bitotina ebisoeno ino, ko l’eoka ya Masiya Yesu.
english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Ende Mungu ako Sango wasu, tala biomaneke ko ndalayalayal Ongoma.
english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

lokele: Liseeli ende boto la boto oyüchomu nda lina lia Masiya. Bitungani ebile lami ono batoseel’ino.
english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

lokele: Ebuchomu batotina batoseel’ino, nde simbi to eba ndakɔ ya Kaisala.
english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

lokele: Booto wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya boyalaneke la belimo yanu.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
